base: Anime visual novel background, detailed digital painting, dramatic lighting, no people, 1280x720, painterly brushwork. Interior of a small intimate basement nightclub in a Tokyo back alley, seen from the middle of the dance floor. Low ceiling with exposed pipes and a simple truss of stage lights, rough concrete walls, a slightly raised DJ booth against the far wall with two decks and a mixer on a dark counter (no brand names, no readable screens), small speaker stacks on both sides, a short bar counter with a few stools along the right wall. Deep violet and cyan beams cut through a light haze; the floor reflects the colored light. Calm and welcoming rather than wild, an open-deck night before the crowd arrives. No people, no text, no letters, no logos, no posters with writing, no watermark.

Subtle camera offset left, booth slightly left of center, right bar clearly visible.
Subtle camera offset right, booth slightly right of center, right-side short bar remains visible.

base: Anime visual novel background, detailed digital painting, night, no people, 1280x720, painterly brushwork. A narrow Tokyo back alley at night between old low-rise buildings, wet pavement reflecting neon. On the right, a steep narrow concrete staircase leads down to a basement door; violet light spills up the stairs from below, as if music is rising from underground. A small lit wall sign by the stairs shows only a thin stitched seam-line symbol (two circles joined by a stitched line), no letters. A few bicycles, an air-conditioner unit, utility poles and wires, a distant warm street light. Quiet, slightly mysterious, inviting. No people, no readable text, no letters, no brand logos, no watermark.
variants: View level from the alley center, stairwell in right foreground.
View from slightly farther back, stairwell at right midground and alley recedes left.
View slightly nearer the stairs, stairwell on right, alley still visible on left.

base: Shop logo for a small Tokyo basement nightclub named "SEAM" (it means the stitched join between two pieces of cloth; at the club it means the join between two songs). Clean modern wordmark reading exactly "SEAM" (S E A M, four uppercase Latin letters, spelled exactly) in bold geometric uppercase letters, with a thin stitched seam line (short dashes) running horizontally through the letters and joining two small circles on either side that suggest two DJ platters. Palette: silver-white letters, violet (#8f6cf0) stitched line, a touch of cyan (#3fd0e8) on one circle. Flat vector-like rendering, crisp edges, readable when shrunk to a small map pin. Centered on a 1536x1024 canvas with generous margins, TRUE TRANSPARENT background. No other words, no tagline, no watermark, no 3D bevel, no gradients, no glow halo that fills the background.
variants: Balanced rectangular geometric letters, circles small and aligned horizontally with word center.
Slightly wider geometric lettering and very small circles, aligned horizontally through center.
Slightly condensed geometric lettering and small outlined circles, aligned horizontally through center.
